text: Barista Express or Barista Pro shots taste sour or bitter: what should I change first?

attempts.why: No card. The Express/Pro sour-shot threads I found are on Home-Barista and Coffee Forums UK (search results show many threads, mostly 2016–2022), but both sites blocked fetching, so they can't count. None of the OzBargain threads I opened raised sour or bitter shots. Worth retrying if Reddit or Home-Barista access becomes available.

This became card barista-express-pro-sour-bitter-what-to-change-first. I folded in the 'gauge doesn't move / watery shot' question because it needs the same diagnosis. Evidence I read: a Lemmy c/espresso thread (2025-05-30), OzBargain node 916284 (2025-07-20) and node 883614 (2024-12-10), plus an older CoffeeForums.com thread (2024-01-06). The scheduler's Reddit fetch returned 403, and reddit.com and old.reddit.com also failed for me. Home-Barista returned 403 on every thread, including several relevant Barista Pro sourness threads such as t94722 and t100004. Coffee Forums UK redirects to a paid crawler gateway that wouldn't resolve. feddit.it blocked me with Anubis, and Team Blind returned 402.
